text:
Situation: Morphine sulfate injection has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2017-10-31 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 56 units of 2 mg/mL 1 mL cartridges (2.7 days on hand). Corvale General holds 308 units of the same concentration and size (15.4 days) plus an additional 317 units (16.7 days). Other Corvale East presentations have 5.4 to 25.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage posting names Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., Hospira, Inc., Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Piramal Critical Care Inc. as affected companies. FDA issued an OAI classification letter to Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC dated 2017-12-28, 58 days after the initial shortage posting, for plant FEI 3001833549 inspected through 2011-07-08. Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 2220525) has had multiple VAI inspections, most recently ending 2024-06-12 with classification known 2024-12-16. Hospira, Inc. (labeler for NDC 00409189001) appears on the shortage list with current status since 2017-10-31.

Our position: Corvale East's 2 mg/mL 1 mL cartridge supply is critically low. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support a transfer while maintaining adequate reserves. No clinical changes are proposed; any formulary or dosing decisions remain with the treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 51 units of morphine sulfate 2 mg/mL 1 mL cartridges from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval required: Pharmacy Director and DEA Form 222 or CSOS order (Schedule II).
2. Transfer 47 units of morphine sulfate 1 mg/mL 10 mL ampules from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval required: Pharmacy Director and DEA Form 222 or CSOS order (Schedule II).
3. Evaluate purchase from Civica, Inc. Approval required: Buyer.
4. Substitute Hospira, Inc. morphine sulfate 2 mg/mL presentation per existing approval by Sam Rivera, MD (2026-08-13). Approval required: Pharmacist verification.
5. Substitute Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC morphine sulfate 2 mg/mL presentation per existing approval by Casey Nguyen, MD (2025-10-09). Approval required: Pharmacist verification.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
